original_question: In the figure, square $ABDC$ is inscribed in $\odot K$. Find the measure of a central angle.
adapted_question: In the figure, square ABDC is inscribed in a circle with center F. Find the measure of the central angle ∠CFD, in degrees.

changes.rationale: The source image labels the center F. Naming F consistently removes the question/diagram mismatch.
C and D are adjacent square vertices, making the intended one-side central angle explicit.

full_mathematical_solution: A square has four equal sides. Equal chords of a circle subtend equal minor central angles.
The four consecutive central angles around F sum to 360°, so each is 360°/4 = 90°.
C and D are adjacent vertices of square ABDC, hence ∠CFD=90° and option C is correct.
